6. Main voting requires going to designated polling station based on residence

videos.title: 점심시간 투표소 북적…서울 투표율 46.1% / 연합뉴스TV (YonhapnewsTV)
videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video caption in Korean, within approximately 500 characters, using 3-5 sentences. The video is about the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections voting day in Seoul.
Key points from the caption:
1. It's the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections main voting day
2. Reporter is at Sangdo-dong polling station in Dongjak-gu, Seoul
3. Voting started 8 hours ago, voters coming since morning
4. Many families came during lunch time on the holiday
5. Seoul voting rate is 46.1% as of 1 PM (정호), increased by 1% in one hour
6. High early voting turnout may continue to main voting
7. Interviews with voters about exercising their rights
8. 2,206 polling stations in Seoul, 6.3 million eligible voters (excluding early voters)
9. Two-step voting process: first for mayor/education superintendent/district head, second for city council/district council/proportional representatives
10. Must vote at designated polling station (unlike early voting), need photo ID (resident registration, passport, driver's license), no photos of IDs or mobile ID screenshots allowed
11. No photos inside polling booth or with ballot as background, but hand stamp and outside photos allowed
12. Police on highest alert (Gapo emergency), only one 112 report so far
13. Voting until 6 PM
I need to summarize this in 3-5 sentences, around 500 characters, in Korean only.
